verdict.rationale: Square clearly supports in-person payments: Tap to Pay on iPhone accepts contactless cards and wallets with no extra hardware, and docs mention processing payments on Square hardware. New accounts start with a default location managed in the Square Dashboard. Nothing in the evidence documents the onboarding and approval flow, its timeline, or ordering hardware from the dashboard. Missing for 10: documented signup/approval process and speed, dashboard hardware ordering, evidence of same-week time-to-first-payment, independent hands-on corroboration of onboarding.
